description: This header file declares the `dm_dpp_t` class, which provides functionalities related to DPP (Device Provisioning Protocol) within a Wi-Fi mesh system. It includes methods for initialization, encoding/decoding JSON data, analyzing configuration, and accessing DPP information. The file also defines the interface and data members for managing DPP related data in the system.
